And by-and-by the old man says:", "sha256": "7ea8b718291cc83bdec7b48702b1ea3fe38cd6d1b38a0322a00adb979be61eab", "source_location": "div.chapter[47]/*[2]", "source_html": "The old man was uptown again before breakfast, but couldn’t get no track of Tom; and both of them set at the table thinking, and not saying nothing, and looking mournful, and their coffee getting cold, and not eating anything. And by-and-by the old man says:"}, {"id": "043-045-0003", "tag": "p", "text": "“Did I give you the letter?”", "sha256": "9dab4e04ef6bb25fdd621df9b2f086c49379006f8affdf6dd5ac6e641eacec8e", "source_location": "div.chapter[47]/*[3]", "source_html": "“Did I give you the letter?”"}, {"id": "043-045-0004", "tag": "p", "text": "“What letter?”", "sha256": "b62cbf00bdc0162cfc4065cd3061ef8e7ddbb4b04f422bcc4170723060960614", "source_location": "div.chapter[47]/*[4]", "source_html": "“What letter?”"}, {"id": "043-045-0005", "tag": "p", "text": "“The one I got yesterday out of the post-office.”", "sha256": "e4720558212f808803e60b2e78bea0698849ed0445a4709ccaab5ab8a5422ec8", "source_location": "div.chapter[47]/*[5]", "source_html": "“The one I got yesterday out of the post-office.”"}, {"id": "043-045-0006", "tag": "p", "text": "“No, you didn’t give me no letter.”", "sha256": "992a3930b82968a0ffb5d741a41b245dfe8773884e748cb0fb9683fb65986f3c", "source_location": "div.chapter[47]/*[6]", "source_html": "“No, you didn’t give me no letter.”"}, {"id": "043-045-0007", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, I must a forgot it.”", "sha256": "0b91538456eee68a2c9c902e62407c46a6519e6043c08f11248a5f15b853bcdb", "source_location": "div.chapter[47]/*[7]", "source_html": "“Well, I must a forgot it.”"}, {"id": "043-045-0008", "tag": "p", "text": "So he rummaged his pockets, and then went off somewheres where he had laid it down, and fetched it, and give it to her. She says:", "sha256": "d6badd3cbd8d12ea300a7e14721df1f1a971b9110a3223fccb1fb8df897c3332", "source_location": "div.chapter[47]/*[8]", "source_html": "So he rummaged his pockets, and then went off somewheres where he had laid it down, and fetched it, and give it to her. She says:"}, {"id": "043-045-0009", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, it’s from St. Petersburg—it’s from Sis.”", "sha256": "8ccba063e43664856b6dd1db7e795af569e4643c765a2cebe7fe5bad3af2ddf0", "source_location": "div.chapter[47]/*[9]", "source_html": "“Why, it’s from St. Petersburg—it’s from Sis.”"}, {"id": "043-045-0010", "tag": "p", "text": "I allowed another walk would do me good; but I couldn’t stir. But before she could break it open she dropped it and run—for she see something. And so did I. It was Tom Sawyer on a mattress; and that old doctor; and Jim, in her calico dress, with his hands tied behind him; and a lot of people. I hid the letter behind the first thing that come handy, and rushed. She flung herself at Tom, crying, and says:", "sha256": "32ce357720fcf98b0adbb34a01fb8b4fd3a1dff9ffab281508aff6dc01b3ecc5", "source_location": "div.chapter[47]/*[10]", "source_html": "I allowed another walk would do me good; but I couldn’t stir. But before she could break it open she dropped it and run—for she see something. And so did I. It was Tom Sawyer on a mattress; and that old doctor; and Jim, in her calico dress, with his hands tied behind him; and a lot of people. I hid the letter behind the first thing that come handy, and rushed. She flung herself at Tom, crying, and says:"}, {"id": "043-045-0011", "tag": "p", "text": "“Oh, he’s dead, he’s dead, I know he’s dead!”", "sha256": "3f20a406689c25068907fb6b8f8f8c3714ecaafe90f23c094c641a64385ec52d", "source_location": "div.chapter[47]/*[11]", "source_html": "“Oh, he’s dead, he’s dead, I know he’s dead!”"}, {"id": "043-045-0012", "tag": "p", "text": "And Tom he turned his head a little, and muttered something or other, which showed he warn’t in his right mind; then she flung up her hands, and says:", "sha256": "3c084290f461646f37577f38823e89b0357dcd37a0b58c2416696bfafc8a729f", "source_location": "div.chapter[47]/*[12]", "source_html": "And Tom he turned his head a little, and muttered something or other, which showed he warn’t in his right mind; then she flung up her hands, and says:"}, {"id": "043-045-0013", "tag": "p", "text": "“He’s alive, thank God! And that’s enough!” and she snatched a kiss of him, and flew for the house to get the bed ready, and scattering orders right and left at the niggers and everybody else, as fast as her tongue could go, every jump of the way.", "sha256": "3775e834da93ff463886bd4dfe5a074c8ecc9e20a9f9563adf990e60b818f8ff", "source_location": "div.chapter[47]/*[13]", "source_html": "“He’s alive, thank God! And that’s enough!” and she snatched a kiss of him, and flew for the house to get the bed ready, and scattering orders right and left at the niggers and everybody else, as fast as her tongue could go, every jump of the way."}, {"id": "043-045-0014", "tag": "p", "text": "I followed the men to see what they was going to do with Jim; and the old doctor and Uncle Silas followed after Tom into the house. The men was very huffy, and some of them wanted to hang Jim for an example to all the other niggers around there, so they wouldn’t be trying to run away like Jim done, and making such a raft of trouble, and keeping a whole family scared most to death for days and nights. But the others said, don’t do it, it wouldn’t answer at all; he ain’t our nigger, and his owner would turn up and make us pay for him, sure. So that cooled them down a little, because the people that’s always the most anxious for to hang a nigger that hain’t done just right is always the very ones that ain’t the most anxious to pay for him when they’ve got their satisfaction out of him.", "sha256": "8e1ff873e6ad707487d7e4426d955e0d365629d7bd944b87aa66541d11d6cbac", "source_location": "div.chapter[47]/*[14]", "source_html": "I followed the men to see what they was going to do with Jim; and the old doctor and Uncle Silas followed after Tom into the house. The men was very huffy, and some of them wanted to hang Jim for an example to all the other niggers around there, so they wouldn’t be trying to run away like Jim done, and making such a raft of trouble, and keeping a whole family scared most to death for days and nights. But the others said, don’t do it, it wouldn’t answer at all; he ain’t our nigger, and his owner would turn up and make us pay for him, sure. So that cooled them down a little, because the people that’s always the most anxious for to hang a nigger that hain’t done just right is always the very ones that ain’t the most anxious to pay for him when they’ve got their satisfaction out of him."}, {"id": "043-045-0015", "tag": "p", "text": "They cussed Jim considerble, though, and give him a cuff or two side the head once in a while, but Jim never said nothing, and he never let on to know me, and they took him to the same cabin, and put his own clothes on him, and chained him again, and not to no bed-leg this time, but to a big staple drove into the bottom log, and chained his hands, too, and both legs, and said he warn’t to have nothing but bread and water to eat after this till his owner come, or he was sold at auction because he didn’t come in a certain length of time, and filled up our hole, and said a couple of farmers with guns must stand watch around about the cabin every night, and a bulldog tied to the door in the daytime; and about this time they was through with the job and was tapering off with a kind of generl good-bye cussing, and then the old doctor comes and takes a look, and says:", "sha256": "675dc9682aa64ef53e11dabd2ee222dfb1d938feaa2a33bb7e643968472d25e2", "source_location": "div.chapter[47]/*[15]", "source_html": "They cussed Jim considerble, though, and give him a cuff or two side the head once in a while, but Jim never said nothing, and he never let on to know me, and they took him to the same cabin, and put his own clothes on him, and chained him again, and not to no bed-leg this time, but to a big staple drove into the bottom log, and chained his hands, too, and both legs, and said he warn’t to have nothing but bread and water to eat after this till his owner come, or he was sold at auction because he didn’t come in a certain length of time, and filled up our hole, and said a couple of farmers with guns must stand watch around about the cabin every night, and a bulldog tied to the door in the daytime; and about this time they was through with the job and was tapering off with a kind of generl good-bye cussing, and then the old doctor comes and takes a look, and says:"}, {"id": "043-045-0016", "tag": "p", "text": "“Don’t be no rougher on him than you’re obleeged to, because he ain’t a bad nigger. When I got to where I found the boy I see I couldn’t cut the bullet out without some help, and he warn’t in no condition for me to leave to go and get help; and he got a little worse and a little worse, and after a long time he went out of his head, and wouldn’t let me come a-nigh him any more, and said if I chalked his raft he’d kill me, and no end of wild foolishness like that, and I see I couldn’t do anything at all with him; so I says, I got to have help somehow; and the minute I says it out crawls this nigger from somewheres and says he’ll help, and he done it, too, and done it very well. Of course I judged he must be a runaway nigger, and there I was! and there I had to stick right straight along all the rest of the day and all night. It was a fix, I tell you! I had a couple of patients with the chills, and of course I’d of liked to run up to town and see them, but I dasn’t, because the nigger might get away, and then I’d be to blame; and yet never a skiff come close enough for me to hail. So there I had to stick plumb until daylight this morning; and I never see a nigger that was a better nuss or faithfuller, and yet he was risking his freedom to do it, and was all tired out, too, and I see plain enough he’d been worked main hard lately. I liked the nigger for that; I tell you, gentlemen, a nigger like that is worth a thousand dollars—and kind treatment, too. I had everything I needed, and the boy was doing as well there as he would a done at home—better, maybe, because it was so quiet; but there I was, with both of ’m on my hands, and there I had to stick till about dawn this morning; then some men in a skiff come by, and as good luck would have it the nigger was setting by the pallet with his head propped on his knees sound asleep; so I motioned them in quiet, and they slipped up on him and grabbed him and tied him before he knowed what he was about, and we never had no trouble. And the boy being in a kind of a flighty sleep, too, we muffled the oars and hitched the raft on, and towed her over very nice and quiet, and the nigger never made the least row nor said a word from the start. He ain’t no bad nigger, gentlemen; that’s what I think about him.”"}, {"id": "043-045-0017", "tag": "source_caption", "text": "The Doctor speaks for Jim", "sha256": "7a393cf0c4583632baf8a480d7624f1f5fcb11965d51623d65ead5119a8433a4", "source_location": "illustration-index/#c42-357", "image_id": "c42-357"}, {"id": "043-045-0018", "tag": "p", "text": "Somebody says:", "sha256": "e9cb39fa03226c70dbb7d5f034d1743a27c50f58786a7e6a03ca879782deda19", "source_location": "div.chapter[47]/*[18]", "source_html": "Somebody says:"}, {"id": "043-045-0019", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, it sounds very good, doctor, I’m obleeged to say.”", "sha256": "7ff9dbc4732db98320b9d8acf51eaa34743c43a97da98a18f55a3e8cd1f2a9f3", "source_location": "div.chapter[47]/*[19]", "source_html": "“Well, it sounds very good, doctor, I’m obleeged to say.”"}], "final_rows": [{"source_id": "043-045-heading", "target": "ГЛАВА XLII.", "source_sha256": "43f45714ee0ef43346898d36e608a14a354de9bbf59be14d9c628b42e0dc5c99", "target_id": "ru-043-045-heading", "tag": "heading", "target_sha256": "f40761094154b45662567a24b617500134fa16fbbc85ef98da9cf00ce15a23ce"}, {"source_id": "043-045-0001", "target": "Том Сойер ранен.—Рассказ доктора.—Том признаётся.—Приезд тёти Полли.—Выкладывайте письма.", "source_sha256": "fd860502f01e65635d682e0e8cd335dc20fb916391d1b3793bef1b5d22037c89", "target_id": "ru-043-045-0001", "tag": "source_argument", "target_sha256": "4c7e2df35bd0e3a5ce71f100d1f4bf23250294c348e642870e785561909d7111"}, {"source_id": "043-045-0002", "target": "Старик ещё до завтрака снова сходил в верхнюю часть города, но так и не напал на след Тома; и оба сидели за столом, думали и ничего не говорили, и вид у них был унылый, и кофе у них стыл, и они ничего не ели. А немного погодя старик говорит:", "source_sha256": "7ea8b718291cc83bdec7b48702b1ea3fe38cd6d1b38a0322a00adb979be61eab", "target_id": "ru-043-045-0002", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "6d2fd3ca564442ac0e66af67bdb9d058637171b2ed46e468d05c5f5eb5ce08da"}, {"source_id": "043-045-0003", "target": "— Я отдал тебе письмо?", "source_sha256": "9dab4e04ef6bb25fdd621df9b2f086c49379006f8affdf6dd5ac6e641eacec8e", "target_id": "ru-043-045-0003", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "03fd5ab3b10c37691c891eff3e5a3bc525c2d45aa6c44a65fa7928ecdb32ff43"}, {"source_id": "043-045-0004", "target": "— Какое письмо?", "source_sha256": "b62cbf00bdc0162cfc4065cd3061ef8e7ddbb4b04f422bcc4170723060960614", "target_id": "ru-043-045-0004", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "883213931b26eb634353076bb49ed45698bdbd7e5585f8d19f0d616fe03fd945"}, {"source_id": "043-045-0005", "target": "— Которое я вчера получил на почте.", "source_sha256": "e4720558212f808803e60b2e78bea0698849ed0445a4709ccaab5ab8a5422ec8", "target_id": "ru-043-045-0005", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "5bca5261b927a458c3d03876641604d2c30e56311625570aec343d649283995c"}, {"source_id": "043-045-0006", "target": "— Нет, никакого письма ты мне не отдавал.", "source_sha256": "992a3930b82968a0ffb5d741a41b245dfe8773884e748cb0fb9683fb65986f3c", "target_id": "ru-043-045-0006", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "4160d1fcb6b97519a779d41c617757dab5cbd386224dcdbb656a8fa1c99b313e"}, {"source_id": "043-045-0007", "target": "— Ну, значит, я забыл.", "source_sha256": "0b91538456eee68a2c9c902e62407c46a6519e6043c08f11248a5f15b853bcdb", "target_id": "ru-043-045-0007", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "94c06c4e17e98efaf9830bd5392d0c20eb47c2da78b2fa7e4704325536e37f94"}, {"source_id": "043-045-0008", "target": "Он обшарил карманы, потом пошёл куда-то, где его положил, принёс и отдал ей. Она говорит:", "source_sha256": "d6badd3cbd8d12ea300a7e14721df1f1a971b9110a3223fccb1fb8df897c3332", "target_id": "ru-043-045-0008", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "17cdc3e8e3d7f357229a97f6a59f788de560cb4416c187ddea773ab677c1c1d7"}, {"source_id": "043-045-0009", "target": "— Да это ведь из Санкт-Петербурга — это от Сестры.", "source_sha256": "8ccba063e43664856b6dd1db7e795af569e4643c765a2cebe7fe5bad3af2ddf0", "target_id": "ru-043-045-0009", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "ce7b466fd6f20d33ac33110451ba9d3b0ab5299cf97f48849ab4ad04388dcac2"}, {"source_id": "043-045-0010", "target": "Я подумал, что ещё одна прогулка мне не помешает, но с места двинуться не мог. Только она не успела его распечатать, как выронила письмо и бросилась бежать — она что-то увидела. И я тоже. Это был Том Сойер на матрасе; и тот старый доктор; и Джим в её ситцевом платье, со связанными за спиной руками; и куча народу. Я спрятал письмо за первое, что подвернулось под руку, и бросился туда. Она кинулась к Тому, плача, и говорит:", "source_sha256": "32ce357720fcf98b0adbb34a01fb8b4fd3a1dff9ffab281508aff6dc01b3ecc5", "target_id": "ru-043-045-0010", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "cc7813178810e85b8401bf81bcb9963aca405cd62969ae3a390fc812b1adf5c9"}, {"source_id": "043-045-0011", "target": "— Ох, он умер, он умер, я знаю, что он умер!", "source_sha256": "3f20a406689c25068907fb6b8f8f8c3714ecaafe90f23c094c641a64385ec52d", "target_id": "ru-043-045-0011", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "023f28614f188bf83472e315c9f41029a427864b87417a00ea45f7a134e0c7e3"}, {"source_id": "043-045-0012", "target": "А Том чуть повернул голову и пробормотал что-то невнятное, из чего было видно, что он не в своём уме; тогда она всплеснула руками и говорит:", "source_sha256": "3c084290f461646f37577f38823e89b0357dcd37a0b58c2416696bfafc8a729f", "target_id": "ru-043-045-0012", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "7a16f1add249e5aa833f2ccb23ae3aec960cee6882d4fc60814555d0a239e511"}, {"source_id": "043-045-0013", "target": "— Он жив, слава Богу! И этого довольно! — и она торопливо чмокнула его и полетела в дом готовить постель, раздавая приказания направо и налево неграм и всем прочим, так быстро, как только мог ворочаться язык, на каждом шагу.", "source_sha256": "3775e834da93ff463886bd4dfe5a074c8ecc9e20a9f9563adf990e60b818f8ff", "target_id": "ru-043-045-0013", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "5a46946dfd0061c1011d04cb22909d20a895e5539ae98f21d0ac77449256c771"}, {"source_id": "043-045-0014", "target": "Я пошёл за мужчинами посмотреть, что они станут делать с Джимом; а старый доктор и дядя Сайлас пошли за Томом в дом. Мужчины были очень злы, и некоторые хотели повесить Джима в назидание всем остальным здешним неграм, чтобы те не пытались убегать, как Джим, и не устраивали столько хлопот, и не держали целую семью дни и ночи в таком страхе, что чуть не умерли со страху.
